caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden flute positioned diagonally from the upper left to the lower right against a plain, light beige background. The flute is cylindrical and predominantly brown in color with light cream-colored rings at three intervals: near each end and in the middle. There are seven black holes aligned along the length of the instrument and a metallic key mechanism is attached at the upper end near the first hole. The ends of the flute are smooth and rounded, and there are no additional objects or decorative elements present in the drawing.
title: Zoar Flute Recorder
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
